en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a richly decorated Catholic church sanctuary. In the center is the main altar with a tabernacle, tall candlesticks, crucifix, statues, and floral arrangements. Side altars with statues of saints and potted plants flank it on both sides. Stained‑glass windows rise behind the altars, and wooden communion rails and benches are visible in the foreground. On the right border of the postcard is printed information about the photographer and location, along with several heraldic coats of arms.
